about_short_description.short_description: Gaiia offers an operating system for Telcos that focuses on billing, operations, inventory, automation, workforce, and network.

product.name: gaiia OSS/BSS Platform
product.description: An AI-enabled operating system for internet service providers that combines customer, billing, network, inventory, workforce, and operational workflows in one platform.

product.name: Billing & Revenue Management
product.description: A configurable billing engine for recurring subscriptions, one-time charges, prorations, payments, invoicing, and usage-based revenue management.

product.name: Workflows
product.description: A workflow automation engine for building step-by-step processes across provisioning, ticketing, notifications, customer lifecycle events, and network operations.

product.name: Customer Management
product.description: A centralized customer and account management system for viewing, servicing, billing, and retaining residential, commercial, and enterprise customers.

product.name: Customer Portal
product.description: A self-service portal where subscribers can manage plans, payments, account details, billing history, and support requests.

product.name: Checkout
product.description: A customizable online checkout for address qualification, service selection, installation booking, and secure payment collection.
